text: Harbor County health score dropped to 48. Renewal is 10/15. They want a roadmap conversation with product before they commit.
What's driving the drop — support volume or usage?
Both. 19 open cases, most of them SPED goal-bank related. And their analytics usage fell off a cliff after the June release.
The analytics drop is probably ANL-401 — p95 load is 11s on tenants their size. We're on it but it's not landing until next sprint.
